events.event: The IHSG closed down 0.30% at 5,304.76 on 17 November, with CNBC Indonesia citing Asia growth worries, higher external debt data, the pending UMP 2027 decision and rupiah pressure ahead of the BI rate decision.
events.key_numbers: IHSG 5,304.76 (-16.23 pts, -0.30%) on 17 Nov · open 5,309.86 · range 5,292.95-5,385.14 · volume 288.54 million lots · value Rp8.85T · utilities -1.20%, basic materials -0.84%, energy -0.68% · drags BBCA, AMMN, BRMS, BRPT, ENRG
events.why_it_matters: The index is stuck just above 5,300 while everyone waits for BI's decision on Wednesday.
events.spreading_evidence: daily close covered by CNBC, detik, Bisnis

events.event: The rupiah closed at Rp18,256 per US dollar on 17 November, slightly stronger by 0.07% per Bisnis, after detikFinance said the dollar was almost Rp18,300 in the morning.
events.key_numbers: Rupiah close Rp18,256/USD (+0.07%) on 17 Nov (Bisnis headline) · Bisnis 16 Nov close Rp18,268 · CNBC/Refinitiv 16 Nov close Rp18,245 · detik morning 17 Nov 'almost Rp18,300' · record-weak close remains 8 Jun Rp18,170 per storyline note, so these levels are weaker than that (storyline rule needs vendor check)
events.why_it_matters: A weaker rupiah makes imports, fuel and overseas tuition more expensive, and it is the main pressure on BI's rate decision.
events.spreading_evidence: detikFinance terpopuler #3 'Dolar AS Pagi Ini Hampir Rp 18.300!'

events.event: Ahead of Bank Indonesia's RDG decision on 18 November, a Bloomberg survey of 32 economists and analysts is split, with 11 expecting a hike to 6% and the median expecting a hold at 5.75%.
events.key_numbers: BI-Rate now 5.75% (per storyline, Jul-Sep hold) · Bloomberg survey n=32: 11 hike to 6%, about 21 hold (derived), median 5.75% · BCA chief economist David Sumual expects 6%, citing that rupiah depreciation above 2.5% wipes out foreign investors' dollar gains · LPEM FEB UI expects hold at 5.75% · RDG 17-18 Nov
events.why_it_matters: The BI-Rate sets mortgage, loan and deposit rates and decides whether the rupiah gets support; this corrects the earlier 'widely expected to hike' framing (E0601).
events.spreading_evidence: Bisnis, Kontan, Bloomberg Technoz, Rancak, mediakompeten all ran RDG previews

events.event: Bank Indonesia reported Indonesia's external debt (ULN) at US$458.9 billion in Q3 2026, up from US$455.4 billion in Q2.
events.key_numbers: ULN Q3 2026 US$458.9B (Antara headline and CNBC body) vs Q2 US$455.4B · +7.2% y/y · government US$220.2B (Q2 216.3) · private US$196.3B (Q2 196.7) · 30.9% of GDP · released 16 Nov
events.why_it_matters: External debt owed in dollars gets heavier to repay when the rupiah is near Rp18,300.
events.spreading_evidence: cited by CNBC as a market driver on 17 Nov

events.event: Antam's 24-carat gold price was Rp2,515,000 per gram on 17 November, down Rp7,000, while the buyback price fell Rp20,000 to Rp2,278,000.
events.key_numbers: Antam sell Rp2,515,000/g (-Rp7,000) · buyback Rp2,278,000/g (-Rp20,000) · spread Rp237,000/g · 17 Nov
events.why_it_matters: Many Indonesians park savings in gold, and the gap between buy and buyback price shows what a quick resale costs.

events.event: KSPI president and presidential adviser Said Iqbal said President Prabowo has not decided who will manage the planned severance (pesangon) reserve fund, with BPJS Ketenagakerjaan, Danantara or a new body as options, and that he leans to Danantara.
events.key_numbers: 3 options: BPJS Ketenagakerjaan, Danantara (BPI), new body · BPJS route needs amending 2 laws (SJSN, BPJS Ketenagakerjaan) · Danantara route could be a government regulation · no rupiah amounts given · press conference 16 Nov
events.why_it_matters: It decides who holds money meant to protect laid-off workers when their employer cannot pay severance.

events.event: OJK announced it named suspects, three of them detained, over alleged manipulation of warrant trading on the IDX involving accounts opened with other people's identities.
events.key_numbers: 4 suspects named, 3 detained (held at Bareskrim) · estimated loss Rp6.97 billion (headline says 3 suspects) · trading day 29 May 2023 · instruments CHEM-W, DOOH-W and 3 structured warrants · OJK investigation order May 2026
events.why_it_matters: It shows OJK following through on market-manipulation enforcement while MSCI is watching for coordinated trading.

events.event: LPSK said restitution for 5,102 qualified victims of the Dana Syariah Indonesia (DSI) P2P lending fraud totals Rp1.07 trillion, and its report went to Kejari Depok on 21 October.
events.key_numbers: 5,102 victims · Rp1.07T total restitution (about Rp209 million per victim, our calc) · applications 1 Apr-16 May 2026 · report to Kejari Depok 21 Oct 2026
events.why_it_matters: It shows how much ordinary investors lost in a sharia fintech Ponzi case and when they might get money back.

events.event: OJK's banking supervision head Dian Ediana Rae said OJK is still drafting policy on bank consolidation and capital (modal inti) requirements, to be applied gradually, while CNBC also reported OJK drafting rules for mini banks to upgrade.
events.key_numbers: No threshold, bank count or deadline disclosed · 2027 capital deadline mentioned · OJK also warned banks on lending amid weak purchasing power
events.why_it_matters: Small banks may be forced to merge or raise capital, which could affect depositors and bank shares.
